Color Name to Hex

All 148 CSS color names with hex values — search, click to copy, or convert hex back to a name.

Click any color to copy its hex.

No colors match your search.

📖 How to use

  1. Search or scroll the 148 CSS color names.
  2. Click a color to copy its hex.
  3. Or paste a hex to find its name (exact or nearest).

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it include every CSS color?

Yes — all 148 official CSS color keywords, including grey spellings and rebeccapurple.

Can I search colors?

The search box filters by name or hex instantly.

How do I copy a hex value?

Click any color row to copy its hex value.

What if my hex has no exact name?

If there's no exact match, the closest color by RGB distance is shown — clearly labeled as approximate.
